entry.name: jit.gl.bfg
entry.description: Generates OpenGL texture output from a library of procedural basis functions. The functions are processed on the graphics card as OpenGL GLSL shaders. The three categories of functions include noise, fractal and distorted.

attributes.name: adapt
attributes.description: Enable adapt to input (default = 1). When enabled the texture output dimensions will match the input dimensions.

attributes.name: annotation
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: background
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: basis
attributes.description: The name of the basis function to use for the evaluation. (default = noise.perlin)

choices.digest: A hybrid additive and multiplicative fractal
Multiplicative fractal with varying simularity across scales
Variation of Voronoi with distance filtering
Voronoi variation with cells colorized by ID
Distortion of input texture along 2 axes

attributes.name: basis.inner
attributes.digest: Inner Basis function for distorted functions
attributes.description: Set the innter basis function whenis a distorted type function (default = noise.perlin).

attributes.name: basis.outer
attributes.digest: Outer Basis function for distorted functions
attributes.description: Set the outer basis function whenis a distorted type function (default = noise.simplex).

attributes.description: Colorize the output texture using a cosine function (default = 0). See theattribute for making adjustments to the colorization.

attributes.name: dimscale
attributes.description: The output dimension scaling factor of the output (default = 1 1). Useful for upsampling or downsampling texture output.output.dim = input.dim*dimscale

attributes.description: Adjust the amount of distortion for distorted type functions (default = 1).

attributes.name: rect
attributes.description: Slab geometry rectangle (default = 0 0 1 1). The four values represent normalized coordinates for the left, bottom, right and top sides of the geometry rectangle. To flip the image horizontally useor to flip vertically use.

attributes.name: rectangle
attributes.description: Enable texture rectangle mode on internal texture objects(default = 1). When enabled the internal GL texture is treated as a rectangular texture, and must be referenced using sampler2DRect and sampled using texture2DRect when sampled from a GLSL shader. When disabled the texture dimensions are upsampled to the nearest power of two value, and must be referenced and sampled using sampler2D and texture2D. Certain texture attributes and GLSL effects require rectangle mode disabled.

attributes.description: The dimensional scale factors to use for generating the spatial grid coordinates (default = 1 1).

attributes.description: Simulate cell shading effect whenis(default = 0.5).

attributes.name: voronoi_smooth
attributes.description: Adjust the smoothing factor whenis(default = 64).

attributes.name: voronoise_amt
attributes.description: Adjust the mix between the Voronoi and noise functions whenis(default = 0).

attributes.name: zoom
attributes.description: Adjust both theandvalues to simulate zooming in and out of the function center (default = 1).
